title: David Deutsch on Physics Without Probability
summary: A 2015 talk by David Deutsch with slides and audio about constructor theory and how physics, in particular the many-worlds interpretation, can be framed without probability.
why: Cited in threads on probability and quantum theory as a strong argument that probabilities can be eliminated from physics.

quote.text: Worth a watch especially if you balk at this idea just to to see a strong counter argument.
